title: claimbreak: segmentation-driven cell-type label error in imaging spatial transcriptomics
description: Python package that measures how many cell-type labels segmentation costs in Xenium and CosMx data without ground truth (claimbreak kept-ratio), and stress-tests label-based spatial conclusions under controlled label and count errors. Accompanies: Elgart V, Loscalzo J, Measuring and reducing segmentation-driven cell-type labeling errors in imaging spatial transcriptomics (2026).
